PluginData.Tooltip: 1.0.6 — Spectrum-aligned markers, stable tracks and responsive HUD text.
PluginData.Description: Tactical HUD, ship status, ammunition targets and Quick Refill, shared contacts, hidden distress GPS, and observed combat telemetry. Spectrum / Auto follows native Spectrum signal timing. HUD width adjusts columns; height scales rows and text. Includes capture controls and automatic overlay shutdown. Windows / Pulsar Legacy.
